description: Man Group's 'Trend Following: Equity and Bond Crisis Alpha' found trend strategies paid off in most equity and bond sell-offs since 1960. Approximation: hold every ETF whose 6-month plus 12-month return is positive, equal weight, cash otherwise. Falsified if drawdowns in 2008, 2020 and 2022 are not smaller than buy-and-hold.
title: Multi-asset trend following · 6 and 12 month · 16 ETFs (after Hamill, Rattray & Van Hemert 2016, Man Group)
